action_items: OPTIONAL — On this preview env every entry in /api/listings appears to be an *expanded* multi-lot lot (id contains '_lot_'). No true single-listings exist, so /api/listings/{id}/bids-public shape-when-present test was skipped. The route itself is proven live (returns 404 semantics for bogus id) and its static invariants are already covered. If main agent wants full e2e coverage of the single-listing MaskedBidHistory path, seed one classic /api/listings item with a bid.

OPTIONAL — Download PDF button uses window.open(url, '_blank') which pops a new tab. This is functionally correct (endpoint delivers valid PDF and browsers will save/preview it), but if a *forced-download* UX is desired the button could switch to an <a href download> tag or fetch → blob → object URL approach. Not a bug; behavioural preference only.
critical_code_review_comments: auctions_bids.py fees-preview correctly reads `listing.get('is_tax_free')` as an explicit override AND returns both `is_tax_free`, `tax_status`, and `seller_account_type` in the response so the client / regression tests can pin the invariant. Also returns `total` (alias of `estimated_total`) so both the popover and the tests can read the same field.

listings.py terms/pdf: reportlab implementation strips scripts/styles + whitelists <b>/<i>/<u>, wraps in SimpleDocTemplate, returns Response(media_type='application/pdf'). Live output 8491 bytes starting with %PDF-1.4 — matches spec.

ScrollToTop.js is defence-in-depth: useLayoutEffect + rAF + [60, 300, 700] ms timeouts, plus explicit skip when url has hash OR /[?&](lot|buy_now|target_lot)=/ so deep-links continue to work. Verified live: marketplace scrollY=694 → /lots/{id} scrollY=0 and /lots/{id}?buy_now=1 preserves scrollY=938 while modal opens.

MaskedBidHistory.jsx now polymorphic on listingId XOR (auctionId + lotNumber), and always renders a stable data-testid (masked-bid-history / masked-bid-history-empty / masked-bid-history-loading) so tests can assert render without needing bid data. DOM contains ZERO occurrences of bidder_name / bidder_email / ip_address on the live page — Law 25 / PIPEDA invariant holds.

CompactLotCard buttons: spellCheck={false} + translate='no' on BOTH the outer <button> and the inner <span> for Auto-Bid + Fees. Confirmed live: getAttribute('spellcheck')='false', getAttribute('translate')='no'. iter371 FIX E squiggle root-cause is neutralised.

Deep-link handler in MultiItemListingDetailPage.js reads searchParams.get('buy_now')+'lot', looks up the target lot, and calls handleBuyNow only when buy_now_enabled + buy_now_price != null. Strips ?buy_now=1 from the URL so a refresh doesn't reopen the modal. Clean.
Nit — Download PDF button uses window.open() (opens new tab). If future UX wants forced-download semantics, migrate to <a href download> or blob-URL fetch. Non-blocking.
